They also include two EUTs where EUT1 uses "BCM4366C0" and EUT2 uses "BCM4366B1" and "The difference is the allocation of the antenna cables" Internal photos for EUT2 are identical to those published under the FCC entry for the [[Linksys EA9500 v1]] so this FCC submission may cover both v1 and v1.1 According to [https://forums.smallnetbuilder.com/threads/broadcom-latest-4x4-radio-ups-on-range-and-efficiency.35370/#post-286918 this post] in the '''SNB forums''', BCM43XXC0 radios "PLUS updated firmware is needed for decent MU-MIMO performance" ==Flashing== {{Flashnotice}} ===Flashing OpenWrt=== {{OpenWrt |techdata = https://openwrt.org/toh/hwdata/linksys/linksys_ea9500_v1 |wikipage = https://openwrt.org/toh/linksys/ea9500_v1 |forumpage = https://forum.openwrt.org/t/build-for-linksys-ea9500/1817/1 |github = |target = bcm53xx |subtarget = generic |arch = arm_cortex-a9 |support_commit_id = 209c5918b511d9e406a094ba246a985b640e519f |support_started_version = 21.02.0 |current_supported_version = 24.10.4 |last_supported_version = |image_too_big = |unsupportedfuncntions = [https://openwrt.org/unsupported/wifi_2.4ghz_partly WiFi 2.4GHz partly], WiFi 5GHz partly, MU-MIMO front 8 level LEDs |lan_hardware = Internal: Broadcom BCM53012, External: Broadcom BCM53125S |lan_comment = It has 2 switches for all 8 LAN Gigabit ports |wlan_hardware = 3x Broadcom BCM4366 |wlan_comment = radio0 just supports channel 36 up to 48 + radio2 only 100 up to 140 |usb_sata_comment = |inst_method = GUI OEM, CFE TFTP + serial recovery, see forum |inst_comment = For external image see forum |rec_method = CFE TFTP + serial recovery |rec_comment = |comment = }} {{SCollapse | git • >> | 
bcm53xx: enhance support for Linksys EA9500
1. Add leds and configs
2. Add network configs
3. Add script to clear partial boot flag
4. Hack to use port 5 as cpu port as port 8 connected to eth2
   wont pass any frames
5. Enable EA9500 image generation

Hardware Info:

- Processor - Broadcom BCM4709C0KFEBG dual-core @ 1.4 GHz
- Switch - BCM53012 in BCM4709C0KFEBG & external BCM53125
- DDR3 RAM - 256 MB
- Flash - 128 MB (Toshiba TC58BVG0S3HTA00)
- 2.4GHz - BCM4366 4×4 2.4/5G single chip 802.11ac SoC
- Power Amp - Skyworks SE2623L 2.4 GHz power amp (x4)
- 5GHz x 2 - BCM4366 4×4 2.4/5G single chip 802.11ac SoC
- Power Amp - PLX Technology PEX8603 3-lane, 3-port PCIe switch
- Ports - 8 Ports, 1 WAN Ports
- Antennas - 8 Antennas
- Serial Port - @j6 [GND,TX,RX] (VCC NC) 115200 8n1

Flashing Instructions:

1. Connect a USB-TTL table to J6 on the router as well as a
   ethernet cable to a lan port and your PC.
2. Power-on the router.
3. Use putty or a serial port program to view the terminal.
   Hit Ctrl+C and interrupt the CFE terminal terminal.
4. Setup a TFTP server on your local machine at setup you
   local IP to 192.168.1.2
5. Start the TFTP Server
6. Run following commands at the CFE terminal

   flash -noheader 192.168.1.2:/openwrt.trx nflash0.trx
   flash -noheader 192.168.1.2:/openwrt.trx nflash0.trx2
   nvram set bootpartition=0 && nvram set partialboots=0 && nvram commit

7. Reboot router to be presented by OpenWrt

Note: Only installation method via serial cable is supported at the moment.
The trx firmware has to be flashed to both the partitions using following
commands from CFE prompt. This will cover US and Non-US variants.
